relations.text: 年次報告が、衛星を打ち上げられる限られた供給元の1社としてRocket Lab USAを挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists Rocket Lab USA among the limited number of suppliers able to launch Planet's satellites

source.label: Planet Labs 10-K
source.quote: There are also a limited number of suppliers able to launch our satellites, including ArianeSpace SA, Blue Origin, LLC, Firefly Aerospace Inc., ISAR Aerospace Technologies Inc., Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd., NewSpace India Limited (Indian Space Research Organization), Rocket Lab USA Inc., Space Exploration Technologies Corp.

relations.text: 年次報告が、衛星を打ち上げられる限られた供給元の1社として三菱重工業を挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists Mitsubishi Heavy Industries among the limited number of suppliers able to launch Planet's satellites

source.label: Planet Labs 10-K
source.quote: There are also a limited number of suppliers able to launch our satellites, including ArianeSpace SA, Blue Origin, LLC, Firefly Aerospace Inc., ISAR Aerospace Technologies Inc., Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd., NewSpace India Limited (Indian Space Research Organization), Rocket Lab USA Inc., Space Exploration Technologies Corp.

relations.text: 年次報告が、Googleとの研究開発サービスの提携に触れている
relations.text_en: The annual report cites a research and development services partnership with Google

source.label: Planet Labs 10-K
source.quote: These efforts include our technology partnerships, such as with Carbon Mapper and NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, our partnerships with Telesat and SES as part of the NASA Communications Services Project (“CSP”), and our research and development services partnership with Google LLC (“Google”).

relations.text: 2025年10月にGoogleとの研究開発サービス契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In October 2025 Planet entered into a research and development services agreement with Google

source.label: Planet Labs 10-K
source.quote: In October 2025, the Company entered into an agreement with Google LLC ("Google"), a related party (see Note 14), whereby the Company agreed to provide research and development services relating to testing the viability and performance of a payload integrated on prototype satellites (the "Google R&D Services Agreement").

relations.text: ESGリスクの評価・監視の需要に対応するため、Moody'sと契約した
relations.text_en: Planet agreed with Moody's to address demand for assessing and monitoring ESG risks

source.label: Planet Labs 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Planet entered into an agreement with Moody’s, a leading global integrated risk assessment firm serving financial markets, to explore and address the growing demand for assessing and monitoring solutions on Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) risks.

relations.text: Planetの高頻度の地理空間データをMoody'sの既存サービスの改善に生かす計画を示した
relations.text_en: Planet and Moody's plan to use Planet's high-cadence geospatial data to refine Moody's existing offerings

source.label: Planet Labs 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Planet and Moody’s plan to address how Planet’s high-cadence geospatial data and Moody’s market-leading entity data, methodologies, and products can be leveraged to further refine Moody’s existing offerings spanning ESG, Know-Your-Customer, supply chain and commercial real estate through real-time, on-the ground insights.

relations.text: NASAの通信サービス計画で、Telesat Government Solutionsなどとともに支援に加わった
relations.text_en: Planet is supporting NASA's Communication Services Project alongside Telesat Government Solutions and SES Government Solutions

source.label: Planet Labs 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Planet announced that it is supporting NASA’s Communication Services Project, or "CSP", alongside two partners, SES Government Solutions and Telesat Government Solutions, to demonstrate real-time space-to-space connectivity solutions from Planet’s LEO satellites to other in-space communication satellites operated by SES and Telesat.
source.note: 2022年の発表で、子会社レベルの記載です。

relations.text: 年次報告が、SpaceXが自社ロケットを使い、直接競合に動けばコストと速度で優位に立ち得ると述べている
relations.text_en: The annual report says SpaceX's vertical integration and own launch vehicles could give it cost and speed advantages if it decided to compete directly

source.label: Planet Labs 10-K
source.quote: For example, SpaceX’s vertical integration and use of its own launch vehicles provides cost and speed advantages that could enable it to offer more advanced or lower priced offerings, if they were to decide to compete with us directly.
source.note: 潜在的な競合としての記載です。

relations.text: 年次報告が、Amazon Leoなどの新たな衛星群が参入障壁を下げ、直接競合する可能性にも触れている
relations.text_en: The annual report notes new satellite fleets such as Amazon Leo may lower barriers to entry or lead the company to compete directly

source.label: Planet Labs 10-K
source.quote: In addition, the increase in launch vehicle development along with frequent and routine transport access to space, as well as the new fleets of satellites from companies such as SpaceX, OneWeb and Amazon Leo, may lower barriers to entry and further increase risk of competition or such companies may decide to compete directly.
source.note: 潜在的な競合としての記載です。
